subtitle: 호텔 조식 시간·메뉴 묻기
desc: 호텔 조식실에서 시간, 포함 여부, 식단 옵션을 묻는 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Good morning. What time is breakfast served?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.en: Good morning. Breakfast is served from seven to ten in the dining room on the second floor.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Is it included in my stay?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.en: Yes, breakfast is included with your room. Just show your key card at the entrance.
turns.ko: 네, 조식은 객실 요금에 포함되어 있습니다. 입구에서 키카드만 보여 주세요.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Great. Do you have vegetarian options?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.en: We do. There is an omelet station, fresh fruit, yogurt, and a vegetarian hot dish.
turns.ko: 있습니다. 오믈렛 스테이션, 생과일, 요거트, 채식 따뜻한 요리가 있어요.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Could I also get a coffee to go after I eat?
turns.ko: 식사 후에 커피도 포장할 수 있을까요?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.en: Of course. There is a coffee machine near the exit. Cups are next to it.
turns.ko: 물론이죠. 출구 근처에 커피 머신이 있고, 컵은 오른쪽에 있습니다.

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.en: Right behind you, on the left. Enjoy your breakfast.
turns.ko: 바로 뒤, 왼쪽에 있습니다. 조식 맛있게 드세요.

tips.en: Is it included in my stay?
